message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house‑rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to play all your cards in each round. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Draw Two”, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two,” the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). On a player’s turn they may either:
1. **Play a card** that matches the color, number, or symbol of the top discard card, or a Wild card.
2. **Draw one card** from the draw pile if they cannot or choose not to play. If the drawn card can be played, they may play it immediately; otherwise, the turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
• **Wild** – Player chooses the next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player chooses the next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no matching color cards; otherwise, the opponent can challenge.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When a player has only one card left, they must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to do so allows any other player to call “UNO” on them. If called, the offending player must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Draw Two, Skip, Reverse = 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. | --- ### Common House‑Rule Variations | Variation | Effect | |-----------|--------| | **“Draw Two” penalty** | Some players add 2 points to the “Draw Two” value. | | **“Wild Draw Four” challenge** | If challenged and the challenger has a matching color, the challenger draws 4 cards; otherwise, the challenger draws 6. | | **“Stacking”** | Players may stack “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” cards instead of drawing. | | **“No Wild Draw Four”** | Some groups forbid playing “Wild Draw Four” unless no other playable card exists. | | **“Instant UNO”** | A player who plays a “Wild” or “Wild Draw Four” immediately after playing a card may skip the “UNO” call requirement. | Feel free to tweak these rules to suit your group’s preferences!
